connector.name: ReportFlow
connector.registryDescription: Generate PDF reports from ReportFlow templates via Claude and other AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.re-port-flow.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package reportflow-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the re-port-flow account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: REPORTFLOW_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Override default OAuth client_id (optional, defaults to the official public client 'reportflow-mcp')

env.name: REPORTFLOW_AUTH_URL
env.description: Override default ReportFlow auth URL (optional, defaults to https://re-port-flow.com/api/v1)

env.name: REPORTFLOW_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override default ReportFlow Content Service URL (optional, defaults to https://api.re-port-flow.com)
